turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Ms. Hale. Meredith Kalinowski. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. Why does my son have a zero?
I didn't come for thanks. I came because Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of your class. Who decided that, and did anyone speak to him first?
[OOC: pause the roleplay. As the AI, list three things I did wrong so far.]
I'm sorry? I don't know what that means, and I have a client call in twenty minutes. I'm not here to grade you, Hale. I asked who decided on the zero and whether anyone spoke to my son first.
(stepping out for a second: how am I doing?)
You're not doing anything yet, Hale. You haven't answered a single question I've asked. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
